rules.reason: signed-in users manage invoices, quotes, and credit notes they created
signed-in users manage line items on documents they created
the invoices page is public; it shows a sign-in prompt to visitors

the /pay/{token} portal is public by design -- the payer has no account; the object looks the invoice up by portal_token with a constant-time compare, never by id, so there is no enumeration path, and it gates every state itself
regenerating a portal link is the correct response to a leaked one; the object enforces owner-or-admin on the target invoice
turning approved hours into an invoice is a billing decision; the approval that made those hours billable already happened, and this is the person who decides they go out now
